title: net1 v4 learning rate: 3e-4 and 1e-4 on the broad dataset
description: In the first grid (exp-net1v4-grid-10) every run stopped after 4 to 7 epochs: validation loss was lowest after 1 to 4 epochs at the constant learning rate of 1e-3 and rose after, fastest with the most dropout. This grid tries learning rates 3e-4 and 1e-4 at dropout 0 and 0.05, width 512, net1 v3's other settings, and ranks its runs together with the first grid's on validation rows only.
run: uv run python experiments/net1_train.py "$OUT/net1-d$DROPOUT-w512-lr$LR" --spec experiments/specs/net1v4.json --set dropout=$DROPOUT --set width=512 --set lr=$LR --data "$IN/d30/campaign-train30" "$IN/d60/campaign-train60" --ood competitors="$IN/ood/campaign-ood-competitors" --ood loss="$IN/ood/campaign-ood-loss" --ood rtt="$IN/ood/campaign-ood-rtt" --ood buffer="$IN/ood/campaign-ood-buffer" --compare "$IN/models/net1v3.pt"
